title: Application JSON Instance V2.5
description: A JSON instance of a schema that an application defines: a command to the application, or its response. What the instance contains is the application's; this Data Type says which schema it is an instance of and which instance it answers, so that an application-neutral AIM, such as the Voice Command Interface, can carry any application's messages. In Audio Scene Management the instances are User Commands (CAE-UCM): a request, UserCommandRQ, and its response, UserCommandRS.

ApplicationSchemaURI.description: The address of the schema that Instance conforms to; the receiver validates the Instance against it.

InReplyTo.description: The AJIID of the instance this one answers: a response names its command, so that the one who sent the command can match them.

Instance.description: The instance, as the application's schema defines it.
